grid=[list(map(int,r.split())) for r in rows.splitlines()]

    cs=[j for j,v in enumerate(row) if v==2]
    if len(cs)>=2:
        for j in range(min(cs),max(cs)+1):
            if out[i][j]==5: out[i][j]=3
for j in range(len(grid[0])):

    if len(rs)>=2:

            if out[i][j]==5: out[i][j]=3
print('\n'.join(' '.join(map(str,r)) for r in out))
